title: Nizam bug-fix scope
description: Validates .agent/evidence/<id>-scope.json, the scoped fix that tools/start_path.py reads before a bug-fix implementation may begin.

id.description: Same identifier as the <id> in the evidence file name.

files.description: Repository-relative files the repair may change.

non_goals.description: What this repair does not authorize.

contract_id.description: When set, the repair stays inside this already approved contract and does not repeat the feature path's pre-code gates.
